title: Linux UID 0 User Created Variant
content: Linux audit logs show useradd creating svc-backup with UID 0 on a production server. /etc/passwd changed, then the new account starts an interactive bash session over SSH.

expected.threat_summary: A Linux root-equivalent account is created and used interactively.
key_behaviors: new Linux user is created with UID 0
hunt_checklist: Review Linux audit logs for useradd/usermod/vipw and UID 0 account creation.
Review SSH, sudo, and shell activity by the new account.
expected.correlation_logic: Correlate account file changes, process command line, UID/GID, source IP, SSH login, and shell activity on the same host.
expected.escalation_condition: Escalate when a UID 0 account is created outside approved administration.
expected.analyst_notes: Hand-authored external gold standard case for accuracy/generalization evaluation.
